reason: The OVERTURNED verdict rests on a wrong timeline, and the claimed blind spot caused no miss. (1) CI was not a late release that beat the incentives. The files of yuki0731/biohub-coord-inject are dated 2026-08-25 (CONTEXT l.3147), about 4 weeks before x138 was published (21 Sep, CONTEXT l.1381), so it says nothing about post-x138 silver-zone behaviour. We found it on 26 Sep with a per-member sweep of the 81 band members, running dataset_list for each user (reach0955/intel_0960_0966.json meta.scan), not by watching for new datasets. The proposed 'datasets list --search biohub --sort-by updated' diff would never have flagged it as new. (2) K came through the discussion channel that the feed already covers (743929, found in r20 and quoted in r22). That miss was a triage error ('log only') and was fixed at 28 Sep 04:39Z. It was not a channel gap. So '2 of 2 late gains' does not support adding a dataset channel. (3) Datasets were not a blind spot. Browser scans listed them in r10, r15, r16 and r25; r25 ran exactly this CLI 'datasets biohub by updated' call. The claim 'rounds 20-29 did not list datasets' is false. (4) The proposed call has its own blind spot. Searching 'biohub' misses slugs such as corwin1979/biocel-secw-3f1c84ad, the band's other plug-in (Corwin 0.965). (5) The base rate is near zero. 47 of 81 band members have no public artifact, and only 7 of 53 teams have any public trace. Since the 01:22Z call, 3 datasets were updated, all from owners at 0.953 or unknown. (6) FEASIBILITY: the trigger cannot be met in time. Going from the CI intel (26 Sep 21:11Z) to a ready exp75 took ~15.5 h plus a lab (27 Sep 12:49Z). Weights that need a new runtime patch will not be built and dummied in the claimed ~1 h. The 2 remaining 29 Sep submits are already allocated by MORNING TABLE v1.1 and are free only if they resolve to UNUSED. GPU is ~2.7 h. A port read at ~18:40Z is a single public read that can serve as a final only as V_pub (winner's curse), and it needs the user's yes. Combining P(a team at >= 0.960 releases pluggable weights in ~7 h) with P(1 h port) and ~+0.001 gives E[gain] ~0. The cost is small (3 API calls) but not zero under the ban-caution regime.
fix: Do not log 'OVERTURNED'. Correct the record: CI was a pre-x138 release (25 Aug) found by a per-member sweep, and K came through the covered discussion channel after a triage miss that is now fixed. The v3 refutation of a dedicated harvest stands. Harmless alternative with no new tooling or trigger: fold the existing ad-hoc line ('CLI datasets biohub by updated', as in r25) back into the next 1-2 browser scans that already run (03:13Z, 06:07Z), diffed against round30/scan_recheck.notes.md, as INFO for the finals card only. Anything from a team at >= 0.960 goes to the user as a note, not a build. No build or dummy for a new dataset after 06:00Z, and no change to the MORNING TABLE v1.1 slots.
realistic_gain: ~0 (E[public] < +0.0001). The claimed dataset blind spot missed nothing: CI predates x138 and was found by a member sweep, and K came via the covered discussion feed. At most, an info line for the finals card.
